source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the tropical thorn forest, printed page 242.

blocks.text: Yeh Pakistan ke maidani ilaqon ka sab se zyada phaila hua khushki ka (terrestrial) ecosystem hai. Is ki pehchan xerophytic (khushk-saali bardasht karne wale) paude hain jin ke kaante sabzi khor janwaron ko door rakhte hain aur paani ka nuqsan kam karte hain.

items: Location (jagah): Indus ke maidan, jin mein Punjab ka bara hissa (Bahawalpur, Khanewal, Mianwali, Dera Ghazi Khan), Sindh (Indus River ke saath junoobi ilaqe) aur Balochistan (maghribi ilaqe) shamil hain.
Abiotic Profile: Climate (aab-o-hawa): khushk (arid) se neem-khushk (semi-arid); garmiyon mein darja hararat 50°C tak ja sakta hai.
Water (paani): Bohat kam barish (salana 200 mm se 750 mm).
Key Flora (ahem paude): Prosopis cineraria (Jhand/Kandi), Salvadora oleoides (Peelu/Wan), Capparis aphylla (Karir) aur Vachellia nilotica (Kikar).
Key Fauna (ahem janwar): Oont, houbara bustard, chinkara, golden jackal (gidar), Balochistan gerbil, sehi (porcupines) aur saanp, maslan saw-scaled viper.
Current Status (maujooda haalat): Heavily Degraded (bohat kharab). In "qudrati jangalon" ka zyada tar hissa insani bastiyon aur Punjab ki bari nehri aab-pashi wali kheti ke liye kaat diya gaya hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ke ‘Key Fauna’ mein rattlesnakes likhe hain, lekin rattlesnake (dum par jhunjhune wala saanp) sirf America mein milta hai, Pakistan mein nahin. Pakistan ke thorn forest ka mashhoor zehreela saanp saw-scaled viper (Echis carinatus) hai.

blocks.alt: Khushk maidan ka manzar, ghaas wali dhalwanon par kanton wale darakht aur jhaariyan. Labels: door oont, darakht ke neeche charta chinkara, chattanon ke paas sahi (porcupine), khushk jagah par kundli maare saanp, ghaas mein Balochistan gerbils aur surkh phoolon wali karir ki jhaariyan.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab ke paudon aur janwaron ki fehrist aur tasveer mein rattlesnake hai, lekin rattlesnake (dum par jhunjhuna) sirf America mein milta hai, Pakistan mein nahi. Is liye khaake mein saanp baghair jhunjhune ke bana hai. Pakistan ke thorn jangal ka mashhoor zehreela saanp saw-scaled viper (Echis carinatus) hai jo kundli maar kar khurdari aawaz nikalta hai.

items: Pakistan ke maidanon ka sab se phaila ecosystem; kaanton wale xerophytic paude.
Jagah: Indus ke maidan (Punjab, Sindh, Balochistan); 50°C tak garmi, 200-750 mm barish.
Paude: Jhand, Peelu, Karir, Kikar; janwar: oont, houbara, chinkara, gidar, gerbil, sehi, saanp. Haalat: heavily degraded.
